caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged, open lid. The chest is primarily colored in a dark green shade and features hand-painted floral decorations on its surface. On the visible front and side panels, there are large, stylized red and pink flowers with yellow stems and leaves, accompanied by a few green leaves. The inside of the chest is shown as brown wood. The lid, which is curved and partially open, also bears floral patterns in similar colors—red, pink, and yellow—matching those on the sides. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and there are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Trinket Box
